title: Build the proving ground
outcome: Turn the research into a public operating system for missions, maintainers, and design partners.
deliverables: Launch ranked catalog and mission pages
Recruit the first builders and adopters
successMetric: Catalog, Firebase foundation, and first mission system live

title: Lattice Performance replacement
outcome: Deliver a trustworthy open performance system for organizations with 25–250 employees.
deliverables: Ship authentication, tenant isolation, directory, roles, and audit history
Run reversible self, manager, peer, and upward review cycles
Add goals, evidence, 1:1s, calibration, packets, and reporting
Export one complete open, versioned workspace archive
successMetric: One organization completes and exports a live review cycle

title: Canny → Fider upstream mission
outcome: Preserve the upstream-first proposal while Fider maintainer direction is pending.
deliverables: Keep the public proposal and research traceable
Wait for maintainer direction before implementation
Resume migration validation only through the accepted contribution path
successMetric: Maintainer direction recorded and a representative export available

title: Motion → Open Planner
outcome: Show that a small AI-native team can ship a trusted planning loop without a proprietary model moat.
deliverables: Add explainable rescheduling and BYO AI
successMetric: 20 weekly active users and four-week retention above 40%

title: Dovetail → Open Research Repository
outcome: Deliver a flagship replacement around sensitive data ownership and durable organizational memory.
deliverables: Ship tags, clips, and semantic search
successMetric: Two organizations migrate a live research archive
